{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''YT-1300 light freighter''' was used by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] team known as the [[Yagaran Four]] at some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was heavily armed, and its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] was modified&mdash;albeit dangerously so&mdash;by the [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] known as "[[Maniac]]." When the Yagaran Four activated the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter's]] hyperdrive during a pursuit after a target on the celestial body [[Elin Roe]], however, the [[Light freighter/Legends|craft]] exploded, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the team and sending a [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]] of [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] dust washing over [[Elin Roe's fifth moon]].<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>
